Recall that in lecture we derived the following batch gradient descent (BGD) and stochastic gradient descent (SGD) update rules for logistic regression with $$L_2$$ regularization. This expression uses the same notation used in class where $$X$$ is the $$n$$ by $$p$$ design matrix, $$X_i$$ is a vector containing the values in the $$i'	ext{th}$$ row of $$X, $$ $$y$$ is the length $$n$$ vector of outcomes, $$y_i$$ is a single outcome (either $$0$$ or 1), and $$	heta$$ is a vector containing the model weights.
Batch Gradient Descent:
$$	heta**{(t+1)}=(1-2\lambda)	heta**{(t)}+\alpha[ rac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(y_i-\sigma(X_{i}\cdot{	heta}**{(t)}))X_i]$$
Stochastic Gradient Descent:
$$	heta**{(t+1)}=(1-2\lambda)	heta**{(t)}+\alpha[(y_i-\sigma(X_{i}\cdot{	heta}**{(t)}))X_i]$$
